input_output_shape: B x 256 x H x W
forward: forward(features, valid_mask=None) -> enhanced_features; no GT, no bank update
dtype_policy: Active output is float32 to preserve small residuals under AMP; cold/disabled identity returns the original input object/dtype
valid_mask: Optional bool Bx1xHxW or BxHxW, from image/padding geometry, never GT Ignore for forward
update: update_from_labels(features, labels, valid_mask=None) -> bool; once after current prediction/loss, train only; eval/disabled no-op
labels: Internal official-train IDs 0..7, Ignore255; BxHgtxWgt or Bx1xHgtxWgt; GT resolution >= feature resolution
initialisation: Class-labelled deterministic farthest-point sampling; cold slots remain invalid when insufficient diversity
update_rule: Nearest valid prototype within the GT class, normalised mean, normalised EMA; absent classes/empty slots unchanged
backward_safety: Forward uses detached cloned bank/valid snapshots; later updates cannot mutate saved backward inputs
distributed_scope: Single-GPU training only; multi-rank updates fail explicitly
diagnostics: diagnostics() returns JSON-ready read-only bank/count/cosine/gate/attention/residual evidence
hook_path: PrototypeDiagnosticsHook(interval=50, core_path='decode_head.prototype_adapter.core'); MP sets its own actual core_path
mp_integration: Copy frozen core/hook source into MP; call core once after pixel_decoder, delta=enhanced-features.float(); adapt delta to memories and mask_features with fp32 residual sums; update once after MP loss from that same input, no cross-version imports
